snippet.title: Leon’s Mahjong – Official Trailer (Google Play)
snippet.description:
Leon’s Mahjong is a retro 🎨 pixel-art take on the classic 🀄 Mahjong solitaire — inspired by a bygone era, and built as a quiet rebellion ✊ against today’s mobile game industry.

A Timeless Experience ⏳
🧩 81 handcrafted boards — each with at least one guaranteed solution.
🚫 No forced retention loops.
🔒 No data tracking.
📶 No internet required.
📵 No ads. No popups. No video interruptions.
💳 No in-app purchases — this is not free-to-play.
💵 Priced like apps from 2008.
🎁 All future DLCs and updates will be free.

This isn’t just a tribute to Mahjong — it’s a tribute to my late father ❤️, who introduced me to it in the ’80s. Now, my son Leon helped shape it as the game’s smallest (and loudest) stakeholder.

Three generations. One love for games. 🎮

I hope you enjoy playing Leon’s Mahjong as much as I enjoyed building it.
